# MY3 Wellness Spa

> MY3 Wellness Spa is a luxury day spa in Gachibowli-Raidurg, Hyderabad — in the heart of the city's IT corridor, minutes from HITEC City, the Financial District, Mindspace, Wipro Circle, and DLF Cyber City. It offers Swedish, Thai, Balinese, and deep-tissue massage therapy in private, soundproofed treatment suites, serving local residents and corporate/IT professionals seeking stress relief and wellness close to work.

Address: Gachibowli, Raidurg, Hyderabad, Telangana, India (exact street address placeholder — confirm before launch)
